name: pageforge
description: PageForge and InkBar: PDF tools and true redaction that run entirely in your browser.
author: Ulzuhan

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:go
scripts.build:web: node scripts/copy-pdfjs-assets.mjs && vite build --config vite.config.mts --mode pageforge && vite build --config vite.config.mts --mode inkbar
scripts.build:go: go build -trimpath -o bin/pageforge ./cmd/pageforge && go build -trimpath -o bin/inkbar ./cmd/inkbar
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run test:go && npm run test:http
